notes.title: Anthro Heat Release Plans
notes.notes: [p]Hey there,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for joining us during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]; we hope you enjoyed the demo! We'll still have the demo available on Steam as we continue working towards the game's release later this year. [/p][p][/p][p]Our team is very committed and making good progress, but Quality comes first. You can follow our development progress on our [url="https://twitter.com/anthroheat"]social networks[/url] and also on our [url="https://discord.gg/JpXCzzPvNz"]Official Discord.[/url] Although we don't have a specific release date for the game, we're doing our best to launch it this year! [/p][p][/p][p]In the version we are developing, we already have: [/p][list][*][p]06 Locations (Suite, Bathroom, Gym, Cabin, Locker Room, and Beach).,[/p][/*][*][p]12 Characters (Astera, Atlas, Aurora, Emmy, Garret, Hera, Marina, Riley, Jasper, Sasha, Renée, and Vertex).,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed and improved several gameplay resources, including poses, textures, reported bugs, collisions, dialogues, animations, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]And much more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] [u][b]Wishlist the game now:[/b][/u] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2236060/Anthro_Heat/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Join our Community: [url="https://discord.gg/JpXCzzPvNz"]https://discord.gg/JpXCzzPvNz[/url][/p][p]Check our Website: [url="https://www.anthroheat.com/"]https://www.anthroheat.com/[/url][/p][p][/p]
